correctness.rationale: Independent square-class valuations give degree32 and geometric connectedness; the Jacobian matrix of the four defining quadrics has rank four everywhere, and Riemann–Hurwitz at six tame branch points gives genus17. Character-idempotent decomposition is valid since 7 does not divide the group order. Fifteen exact elliptic quotient counts over F7 give nine trace 0, four -4, two +4; genus-two quotient has F7/F49 counts 8/46 giving Weil numerator 1-2T²+49T⁴. Each of 32 direct F7 fiber counts and separately enumerated homogeneous-projective-model counts agree with independent character sums, yielding m frequencies 18,12,2. Independent F49 direct point enumeration gives 160 for each. The projector decomposition has 2-primary kernel so the 7-divisible group and therefore 7-rank 8 and a-number 9 are preserved. Verifier completed VERIFY_OK. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof; all-extension claim uses Weil cohomology and character factors.

value.rationale: Over F7 the rational projective line has eight points; a six-point branch locus is the complement of two rational points and is unique up to PGL2(F7). The natural 32-element square-class descent set therefore provides a motivated full family rather than arbitrary numerical specialization. Its three complete Frobenius spectra, pointlessness/16/32 distribution, uniform extension-square arithmetic and mixed Newton slopes give a nontrivial complete arithmetic classification. The exact equations and descent markings are essential to the theorem; the known general isogeny decomposition does not compute this invariant.
